schema.title: Response List Cases Api Cases Get

post.description: A question about one site, answered in parts that each say where they came from.

A quick first answer from the site's data alone, to show while POST /api/chat is still at work.

No parts means there is none to show (no live model, switched off, over the limit, a failed call,
or nothing that passed the checks): the page keeps waiting. Why a question is refused is the full
route's to say, so this one never refuses.

CaseConditions.title: CaseConditions
CaseConditions.description: Open on purpose: a case records whatever conditions were publicly reported.

ChatAnswerPart.title: ChatAnswerPart
ChatAnswerPart.description:
One part of an answer, labeled by where it came from.

`warning` and `action` are results of the early-warning and action rules, not records. `not_found`
means it was looked for and nothing was found; `unknown` means a query or a load failed, which is
never shown as zero or none. `notice` is a fixed line from the server (limitations, what was held back).

ChatExchange.title: ChatExchange
ChatExchange.description: One earlier question and the answer text the reader saw, so a follow-up question has its context.

ChatSetup.title: ChatSetup
ChatSetup.description: What a client needs before the first question.

DatasetStatus.title: DatasetStatus
DatasetStatus.description: How one source answered for one site. An error is never shown as zero; capped is "at least".

DrawingConfirm.title: DrawingConfirm
DrawingConfirm.description:
A drawing reading the uploader checked and confirmed: it becomes the project's structural model and
turns into checklist items for the roles it concerns (each saying which document added it and who).

GeotechConfirm.title: GeotechConfirm
GeotechConfirm.description: A geotechnical report reading the uploader checked and confirmed: it turns into checklist items.

GeotechFindings.title: GeotechFindings
GeotechFindings.description: What a geotechnical report states, as read by AI and confirmed by the uploader. Null: not stated.

Lesson.title: Lesson
Lesson.description: A failure mode seen on similar past projects: the incidents, what prevents it, and this lot's own records.

LessonCase.title: LessonCase
LessonCase.description:
A past incident behind a lesson. `basis` says whether its failure mode comes from a reported cause or only
from what happened (no cause published).

LessonItem.title: LessonItem
LessonItem.description: A checklist item that prevents the failure mode.

LessonTag.title: LessonTag
LessonTag.description: One case tagged with this lesson's failure mode, and the basis of the tag.

PatternScore.title: PatternScore
PatternScore.description: Relative to similar sites, never a prediction that a building will fail.

SiteOutlook.title: SiteOutlook
SiteOutlook.description: What could go wrong here, for every option: lessons from similar past projects, worst first.

WarningRuleCheck.title: WarningRuleCheck
WarningRuleCheck.description:
Whether one early-warning rule could be checked for a site. A rule that could not run is an
error, never "no warning"; not_applicable says why the rule does not apply to this site.
